Definition: to quaff, i.e. (causatively) to irrigate or furnish a potion to
BiblicalUsage: To give drink is a small kindness that the Bible notices. The servant's test was the damsel who would say, drink, and I will give thy camels drink also, and the flocks at the well were watered out of it. The psalm lifts the word highest, He watereth the hills from His chambers, and the earth is satisfied with the fruit of His works.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe giving drink is the smallest mercy and the greatest sign, because Rebekah's pitcher marked her as Isaac's wife and God's hills are watered the same way.
